bioShort: Tachy — Cyberpunk musician, 3D creator, and digital performer blurring the lines between sound and code.
bioLong: Tachy is an indie artist and 3D web creator based in Vietnam, known for blending electronic music with immersive digital experiences. From producing genre-defying tracks to building interactive 3D websites, Tachy's work exists at the intersection of music, technology, and visual art.
